rewrites.comment: Same-origin proxy for the API. This is load-bearing, not a convenience: the refresh token is a sameSite=strict cookie, so if the browser sees the API as a different registrable domain it drops the cookie on every request and users log in then instantly log out. Proxying keeps everything on one origin. Replace the destination host with your deployed API.
Uploaded documents served from the API's local-disk fallback. Remove once S3/R2 is configured and files are served from the bucket's public URL.
SPA fallback — react-router owns every non-asset path.
